entries.question: Does the Mesa capsule fit the Vista V3?
entries.answer: Yes, directly. The Mesa clicks onto the frame with no adapters, so a sleeping baby goes from the car to the pram without being unbuckled. entries.answer: For a lot of families, yes. It is from birth as sold, it takes the Mesa capsule with the Minu V3 Mesa adapter, and it carries a child up to 22.7 kg. It is worth thinking twice if you walk long distances every day on rough ground, where a larger wheel earns its keep.

entries.question: My pram was in a car accident. What should I do?
entries.answer: The Crash Exchange Program covers only the Mesa capsule and Mesa base, never prams or strollers. If your Mesa capsule or base was in the vehicle, stop using it and claim within 30 days of the accident on the [Crash Exchange Program](/pages/crash-exchange-program) page. If your pram was damaged, or anything on it no longer locks, stop using it and lodge a request through our [support page](/pages/support) with photographs of the damage and one of the whole pram. The team will tell you what happens next.

corrects_question.q: My pram was in a car accident. What should I do?

entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David: Crash Exchange covers only the Mesa capsule and Mesa base; uppababy.com.au sends accident-damaged prams to Crash Exchange

entries.question: If something is wrong with your product
entries.answer: Lodge a request through our [support page](/pages/support) with your proof of purchase, the serial number and photographs of the fault. We assess it and tell you which outcome applies and why: repair, replacement or refund. If we are repairing, we tell you what and how long it will take before you send anything, and we pay the freight on a product returned for a fault. A pram damaged in a car accident is not a returns question, and it is not covered by Crash Exchange, which is only for the Mesa capsule and Mesa base. Lodge a request with photographs instead.

corrects_question.q: If something is wrong with your product

entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David: Crash Exchange covers only the Mesa capsule and Mesa base; uppababy.com.au sends accident-damaged prams to Crash Exchange

entries.question: Is this actually a warranty claim?
entries.answer: Three other programmes cover things the warranty does not. Mesa capsule or base in a vehicle accident: stop using it and claim under the [Crash Exchange Program](/pages/crash-exchange-program) within 30 days. It covers only the Mesa capsule and base, never prams. A pram damaged in an accident: lodge a request through our [support page](/pages/support) with photographs. Damaged by an airline: the [TravelSafe Program](/pages/travelsafe-program) covers it if you registered an UPPAbaby travel bag before you flew. Needs a service, not a repair: a stiff fold, a squeak or a brake adjustment is a job for a free Tune-Up Day.

entries.question: Accidents, travel and the things a warranty does not cover
entries.answer: Crash Exchange Program: if your Mesa capsule or base was in a vehicle during an accident, stop using it and lodge a claim within 30 days for a replacement. entries.question: Can I fold the Vista V3 with the toddler seat on?
entries.answer: Yes, as long as the seat faces forward, away from you, reclined to the second most upright position. It will not fold with the seat facing you. Take off the bassinet, a RumbleSeat or a Mesa first.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: Can I fold the Cruz V3 with the seat on?
entries.answer: Yes, with the seat facing forward, away from you, reclined to the second most upright position. It will not fold with the seat facing you. Take off a bassinet or a Mesa capsule first. For a smaller fold, lower the bumper bar and tuck the footrest away.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: Which UPPAbaby pram folds with the seat facing either way?
entries.answer: Only the Kona. Its seat can face you or face out when you fold it. The Vista V3 and Cruz V3 fold with the seat on only when it faces forward, away from you, in the second most upright position.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: How do I wash the pram fabrics?
entries.answer: Spot clean, or hand wash in cold water with a mild detergent. Dry the fabric flat in the shade, out of direct sun, and let it dry fully before it goes back on. Do not machine wash, bleach, iron or dry clean the fabrics, and never tumble dry. The harness is wipe only: a damp cloth and mild soap, no soaking. Between washes, a damp cloth and a drop of dish soap handles most marks.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: When can my baby use the toddler seat?
entries.answer: On the Vista V3 and Ridge V2 the toddler seat is from 6 months. Before that, use the bassinet, which comes with the Vista V3, or the Mesa capsule. The Ridge V2 needs the Ridge Mesa/Bassinet adapters for either. The Cruz V3, Minu V3 and Kona are from birth as sold, and the Minu Duo is from birth on both seats.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; uppababy.com.au also says about three months for the Vista seat

entries.question: What age is the RumbleSeat for?
entries.answer: The RumbleSeat V3 is from 6 months, up to 15.9 kg. It fits the Vista V3 and the Vista V2, and brings its own adapters in the box. The main toddler seat on top then goes on the Vista upper adapters, as in any double setup. Put the bigger child in the main toddler seat, which takes up to 22.7 kg, and the smaller child in the RumbleSeat. The Cruz V3, Minu V3 and Ridge V2 do not take a RumbleSeat.
entries.decided_reason: Vista upper adapters: used in any double setup, or to raise a single seat or bassinet; not for another brand's capsule (David, 1 Oct 2026)

entries.question: What is the weight limit on the Minu V3?
entries.answer: The Minu V3 takes a child from birth to 22.7 kg. It is from birth as sold, with the included infant insert. The Minu Duo takes 22.7 kg per seat.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; uppababy.com.au says 22 kg in places

entries.question: Does a BeSafe capsule fit my UPPAbaby pram?
entries.answer: BeSafe capsules are not sold in Australia, so they are not on the approved list for any UPPAbaby pram. The Mesa clicks straight onto the Vista V3, Cruz V3 and Kona, and fits the Minu V3, Minu Duo and Ridge V2 with an adapter. The other capsules that fit, with the matching UPPAbaby adapter, are Maxi-Cosi Mico AP / Mico Plus, Maxi-Cosi Citi, Maxi-Cosi Mico 12 and Mico 12LX (made after 20 April 2022), Nuna PIPA, Nuna KLIK Plus and Joie i-Gemm. The Minu V3 and Minu Duo take only the Mesa. The older Minu V2 also takes select Maxi-Cosi, Nuna and Joie capsules with the Minu V2 Car Seat Adapter.

entries.question: What warranty does a floor display pram have?
entries.answer: A floor display pram bought from a retailer has a 12 month warranty against manufacturing defects, from the date of purchase. An ex-display pram bought from UPPAbaby Australia has the full three year warranty, the same as a new pram. Either way, keep your receipt: we need proof of purchase showing the retailer and the date for any claim.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: Does the Crash Exchange Program cover my pram?
entries.answer: No. The Crash Exchange Program covers only the Mesa capsule and the Mesa base. If either was in the vehicle during an accident, stop using it and lodge a claim within 30 days on the [Crash Exchange Program](/pages/crash-exchange-program) page. Prams and strollers are never covered by Crash Exchange. If your pram was damaged, lodge a request through our [support page](/pages/support) with photographs of the damage and one of the whole pram.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David: Crash Exchange covers only the Mesa capsule and Mesa base; uppababy.com.au sends accident-damaged prams to Crash Exchange

entries.question: Do I need adapters to fit the Mesa to the Kona?
entries.answer: No. The Mesa clicks straight onto the Kona frame with no adapters, the same as on the Vista V3 and Cruz V3, so a sleeping baby can go from the car to the pram without being unbuckled.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; uppababy.com.au has also said the Kona needs a matching adapter set

entries.question: Does the bassinet fit the Minu V3?
entries.answer: No, the UPPAbaby bassinet does not fit the Minu V3. The Minu V3 is from birth as sold, with its included infant insert and a from-birth recline, and the Mesa capsule fits it with the Minu V3 Mesa adapter. The bassinet fits the Vista V3 and Cruz V3 directly, and the Ridge V2 with the Ridge Mesa/Bassinet adapters.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: Who can come to a Tune-Up Day?
entries.answer: Anyone with an UPPAbaby pram can come to a Tune-Up Day. You do not need to have bought it from us or registered it. The team checks, cleans and adjusts the brakes, wheels, harness, fold and canopy in about fifteen minutes, and it is free. Lifetime Service Support is a separate service with its own conditions: complimentary maintenance checks for up to ten years from the original purchase date, for prams bought from an authorised Australian retailer. It passes to a second owner, as long as the pram has not previously been deemed unsafe, although the warranty does not transfer. Replacement parts and major repairs are not included. Spots are limited, so book ahead through our [support page](/pages/support).
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: What do I need to carry a capsule under the toddler seat on a Vista V3?
entries.answer: It depends on the capsule. A Mesa never uses capsule adapters: underneath the toddler seat it goes on the Vista lower adapters, the same as a bassinet, so you need the UPPAbaby Vista Upper Adapter and the UPPAbaby Vista Lower Adapter. Every other approved capsule underneath uses the UPPAbaby Vista Lower Infant Car Seat Adapters, and all approved capsules fit this way, including the Maxi-Cosi Citi and the Britax B-Pod and B-Pod Lite. Never put a toddler seat on the lower adapters: the lower position is only for a bassinet, a capsule or a RumbleSeat.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: Is the UPPAbaby From Birth Kit available in Australia?
entries.answer: No, the From Birth Kit is not sold in Australia. You do not need it here: the Cruz V3 and Minu V3 are from birth as sold with their included infant inserts, the Vista V3 comes with the bassinet in the box, and the Kona seat lies flat from birth.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: What is the warranty on the Mesa capsule?
entries.answer: The Mesa capsule has a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects for the original purchaser. Keep your receipt, as we need proof of purchase for any claim, and [register the capsule](/pages/product-registration) so a claim or recall notice reaches you quickly. If the Mesa was in a vehicle accident, that is not a warranty claim: stop using it and use the [Crash Exchange Program](/pages/crash-exchange-program) within 30 days.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; uppababy.com.au gives three years

entries.question: Where are UPPAbaby prams made?
entries.answer: UPPAbaby prams are designed at the company's headquarters in Massachusetts, in the United States, and made in China under strict quality control. Every pram sold in Australia complies with the mandatory Australian standard, AS/NZS 2088:2000.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: Is there a registration card in the box?
entries.answer: No, UPPAbaby boxes in Australia do not include a registration card, and the serial number is not on the box. It is on the product itself: on a pram, a white label under the frame near the rear axle. Register online on the [product registration page](/pages/product-registration), with your receipt attached.
entries.decided_reason: Confirmed by David; no uppababy.com.au answer covers this

entries.question: Can I collect my online order?
entries.answer: Yes. You can collect an online order from the UPPAbaby Showroom in Braeside, Melbourne, open Monday to Friday, 9am to 2:30pm. Collections must be arranged in advance: call our customer service team to arrange it before you come in. You can also see the range and buy in person at the showroom or at any of our [authorised stockists](/pages/store-locator).

entries.question: What are the Vista upper adapters for?
entries.answer: The [Vista Upper Adapters](/products/uppababy-vista-upper-adapter) raise whatever sits in the top position, by up to 16 cm. A single bassinet, toddler seat or Mesa clicks straight onto the frame without them. Another brand's capsule on top does not use them: it goes on the Vista and Cruz car seat upper adapter instead.

entries.question: Which UPPAbaby pram is right for me?
entries.answer: The [Which UPPAbaby pram?](/pages/find-your-perfect-pram) quiz asks four questions: how many children it will carry, whether you need it from birth, where it will be used most, and whether a second child is possible. Then it suggests a model. To see the specs side by side, use [Compare the range](/pages/product-comparison). For which adapter fits what, use the [adapter guide](/pages/adapters).

entries.question: Can the Ridge V2 take a second seat?
entries.answer: No. The Ridge V2 is a single-seat pram, so it does not take a second seat, a RumbleSeat or a second bassinet. For an older child, add the PiggyBack ride-along board, which takes a standing child up to 25 kg.

entries.question: What kind of buckle and tyres does my pram have?

entries.question: How do I know the brake is on?
entries.answer: Look at the foot brake: red means the brake is on, green means it is off. The Ridge V2 also has a hand disc brake. If it feels less responsive or needs more force, slightly rotate the disc brake knob anticlockwise to tighten it, on both sides, then test it and adjust again until it feels right. If a brake still does not hold, stop using the pram and lodge a request through our [support page](/pages/support), or bring it to a free Tune-Up Day.

entries.question: How do I fold the Cruz V3?
entries.answer: Put the brake on and turn the front wheel locks off, set the handlebar to its lowest position, then squeeze the triggers and fold until it locks. The bumper bar goes down by itself as it folds. With the toddler seat on, it must face forward, reclined to the second most upright position, with the canopy closed.

entries.question: How do I adjust the harness height?
entries.answer: Set the shoulder straps level with your child's shoulders. No rethreading is needed. Keep the buckle clean by wiping it and drying it, and never oil or spray it.

entries.question: Can my newborn use the Vista V3 toddler seat?
entries.answer: The Vista V3 toddler seat is recommended from 6 months. With the Snug Seat fitted, it can be used from birth. Under 6 months you can also use the bassinet, which comes in the box, or the Mesa capsule.

entries.answer: Yes. At 70.6 cm wide, the Minu Duo fits easily through a standard Australian 82 cm doorway.

entries.question: What are the MamaRoo limits?
entries.answer: Stop using the MamaRoo at 11.3 kg or when your baby tries to climb out, which is usually around 9 months. Keep the seat fully reclined until at least 4 months, and use the infant insert until about 4 months. The MamaRoo weighs 6.9 kg, and the recline adjusts to any angle between 25 and 45 degrees. It also has Bluetooth music streaming and Wi-Fi, set up through the app.

entries.question: Can I take an UPPAbaby pram on a plane?
entries.answer: Yes. The Minu V3 is the pram to fly with: it weighs 7.6 kg and folds to 25 x 45 x 55 cm, which meets the IATA overhead standard. Whether it can go in the cabin is up to your airline, so check before you book. Other prams are normally checked at the gate or go in the hold. Pack yours in an UPPAbaby travel bag and register it under the [TravelSafe Program](/pages/travelsafe-program) before you fly, because airline damage is otherwise excluded from the warranty. The Mesa capsule is CASA approved for aircraft use on airlines that permit child restraints.

entries.question: How to lodge it
entries.answer: Lodge a request through our [support page](/pages/support) and choose Warranty claim. Attach your proof of purchase, a photo of the serial number label and photos or a short video of the fault, and add a sentence on when it started and what you were doing. We may ask for one more photo from a specific angle, and we reply within one business day. We then repair it, replace the part or replace the product, whichever is appropriate. Some parts are replaced with newer model parts as products are improved.
